focus: Data visualization, statistics, statistical analysis, and reproducible scientific computing
title: Homogeneous Systems: The Shape of Every Linear Solution
utility_title: CSV Statistics and Reproducible Bootstrap Mean Intervals
utility_use_case: A researcher receives a CSV export of repeated sensor measurements and wants a reproducible first-pass summary of one column before making a figure or sharing a data-quality report. The command produces descriptive statistics, counts excluded blank and invalid entries, and a seeded percentile bootstrap interval for the mean. The JSON output can be archived alongside the input and command so a collaborator can repeat the calculation. The results remain descriptive: they do not demonstrate a causal effect, significance, or that the sample represents a broader population.
